guides.title: No Avatar overview
guides.before_you_start: Read with the engine stopped if you prefer. Any setup, setting change, service action or test is an explicit choice you make.

steps.title: What No Avatar does
steps.body: Audio-only avatar provider. The overview introduces this area without opening its other sections.

steps.title: Recognize intentional audio-only
steps.body: Selecting No Avatar means NC speaks without a visual avatar. If you see no face or animation, that is the intended result rather than a configuration failure. Audio still requires a working speech provider, so silent speech points to text-to-speech, not to this avatar choice.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.
